day3_lunch_start.name: 僕
day3_lunch_start.text: *昼休みを知らせるチャイムが鳴った。今日は金曜日…明日から週末だ。*

day3_lunch_check_dates.name: 僕
day3_lunch_check_dates.text: *席を立とうとすると、複数の視線を感じる。*

day3_lunch_multiple_approach.name: 僕
day3_lunch_multiple_approach.text: *え…ちょっと待て、なんでみんなこっちに…？*

day3_lunch_collision_no_seoyeon.name: 僕
day3_lunch_collision_no_seoyeon.text: *約束した子たちが同時に近づいてくる。これはまずい…*

day3_lunch_collision_no_seoyeon_choose.name: 僕
choices: ユナとランチを食べる
ダインとランチを食べる
みんなで食べようと提案する

day3_lunch_collision_seoyeon_dain.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_collision_seoyeon_dain.text: "Hey, {name}! Let's go eat! Oh... Seoyeon too?"

day3_lunch_tension_1.name: 僕
day3_lunch_tension_1.text: *Suddenly, the classroom fills with tension. Their eyes meeting each other don't look friendly.*

day3_lunch_tension_3.name: 僕
day3_lunch_tension_3.text: *This doesn't look good... What should I do?*
choices: ソヨンとランチを食べる
ユナとランチを食べる
ダインとランチを食べる
みんなで食べようと提案する

day3_lunch_choose_seoyeon.name: 僕
day3_lunch_choose_seoyeon.text: "Seoyeon, let's go together. We had plans from yesterday, remember?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_others_react.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_others_react.text: *I can feel the others' expressions harden.*

day3_lunch_yuna_jealous_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_jealous_2.text: *Yuna leaves the classroom without a word. Her back looks somehow lonely.*

day3_lunch_dain_jealous.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_jealous.text: "What, you're not including me? Hmph, fine!"

day3_lunch_dain_jealous_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_dain_jealous_2.text: *Dain grumbles and goes to her other friends. I'm a bit worried...*

day3_lunch_with_seoyeon_start.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_with_seoyeon_start.text: "Phew... Finally just the two of us. Honestly, {name}, don't you think too many people are interested in you lately?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_jealous_talk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_jealous_talk.text: *There's an unusual edge in Seoyeon's voice.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_deny.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_deny.text: "...Right, I guess so. Sorry, I said something weird."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_tease.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_tease.text: "W-what! Who said I'm jealous! ...Maybe a little."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_weekend.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_weekend.text: "By the way, what are you doing this weekend? I... want to hang out somewhere together if you're free."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_caught.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_caught.text: *Wait, I already have other plans... What should I do?*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_lie.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_lie.text: "Really?! Then let's meet on Sunday! Can I pick where to go?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_honest.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_honest.text: "...What? You have other plans? With who?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_honest_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_honest_2.text: *Seoyeon's eyes turn cold. The atmosphere has frozen.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_dodge.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_dodge.text: "Why are you hesitating? ...Do you have other plans?"

day3_lunch_seoyeon_end.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_end.text: *We finished lunch and sat on a bench behind the school. A gentle breeze is blowing.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench.text: *Quietly leaning her head on my shoulder* "...{name}. I've been strange lately. I think about you every single day."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bench_2.text: *The scent of shampoo from Seoyeon's hair. My heart is racing.*

day3_lunch_seoyeon_pat.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_pat.text: *As I pat her head, Seoyeon buries her face* "D-dummy... Don't do that in a place like this..."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_same.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_same.text: *Seoyeon lifts her head and looks at me* "...Really? I'm going to remember that."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_silent.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_seoyeon_silent.text: *Seoyeon quietly takes my hand* "...This is nice. Just like this."

day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side with Seoyeon on the bench behind the school, chatting.*
day3_lunch_seoyeon_freetalk.context: ソヨンと学校裏のベンチに並んで座っている。ソヨンが肩に頭を乗せて「毎日あなたのことを考えてる」と告白した後。甘い雰囲気。

day3_lunch_seoyeon_bell.name: 僕
day3_lunch_seoyeon_bell.text: *The bell rings for class. Time with Seoyeon felt magically short.*

day3_lunch_yuna_rooftop.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_rooftop.text: *I followed Yuna to the rooftop. Yuna lays down a blanket on the floor and pulls out a lunchbox from her bag.*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_2.text: *Two lunch boxes placed side by side. One with a black lid, one with a pink lid. Did Yuna make these herself?*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_ask.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_ask.text: *Looking away* "...You're perceptive. Throw it away if it's bad."

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_taste.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_taste.text: *I take a bite. Surprisingly... it's actually really good!*

day3_lunch_yuna_bento_eat.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_bento_eat.text: *Watching me eat, she smiles ever so slightly* "...Is it good?"

day3_lunch_yuna_lap.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_lap.text: *After finishing the lunchbox, a gentle breeze makes me drowsy. Yuna suddenly pushes down on my shoulder.*

day3_lunch_yuna_lap_yes.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_lap_yes.text: *As I lie down, Yuna strokes my hair* "...Just five minutes."

day3_lunch_yuna_lap_talk.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_lap_talk.text: *Quietly stroking my hair* "...When we're like this, it feels like you're mine."

day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *Lying on Yuna's lap, looking up at the sky from the rooftop, chatting.*
day3_lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: ユナの膝枕で屋上にいる。ユナがお弁当を作ってきてくれて、髪を撫でている。静かで穏やかな雰囲気。

day3_lunch_yuna_talk_1_jealous.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_talk_1_jealous.text: "...{name}. I thought you were only nice to me."

day3_lunch_yuna_single_end.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_single_end.text: *I spent a peaceful lunch time with Yuna.*

day3_lunch_yuna_talk_2.name: 僕
choices: "I try to be nice to everyone"

day3_lunch_yuna_everyone.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_everyone.text: "...I see. So I'm just one of 'everyone'."

day3_lunch_yuna_question.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_question.text: "...You don't need to know. Not yet."

day3_lunch_yuna_warning.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_yuna_warning.text: "Remember one thing. If you betray me... you'll regret it."

day3_lunch_yuna_warning_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_yuna_warning_2.text: *Yuna's eyes flashed eerily for a moment... That was a joke, right?*

day3_lunch_with_dain_start.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_with_dain_start.text: "Yay! {name} is the best! Let's go, today's lunch is chicken!"

day3_lunch_dain_talk_1.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_talk_1.text: "By the way... did you see Seoyeon's face just now? Totally jealous, right?"

day3_lunch_dain_talk_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_dain_talk_2.text: *Dain glances around and lowers her voice.*

day3_lunch_dain_talk_3.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_talk_3.text: "Hey, be honest with me. Are you dating Seoyeon? Or Yuna? I know they're both interested in you."

day3_lunch_dain_confess.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_confess.text: "W-what?! Saying that out of nowhere... Geez!"

day3_lunch_dain_friends.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_friends.text: "Hmm, really? Their faces say otherwise though... Well, whatever!"

day3_lunch_dain_jealous_tease.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_jealous_tease.text: "Huh?! Who's jealous! I'm just curious! ...Maybe a little bothered though!"

day3_lunch_dain_serious.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_serious.text: *Suddenly putting down her chopsticks, quietly* "...{name}. Let me ask you something seriously."

day3_lunch_dain_serious_2.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_serious_2.text: "...What am I to you? Just a friend? Or... something else?"

day3_lunch_dain_serious_choice.name: 僕
day3_lunch_dain_serious_choice.text: *Dain's eyes are different from usual. She's serious.*

day3_lunch_dain_special.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_special.text: *Her face turns beet red and she punches my arm* "Wh-what?! Really?! My heart almost exploded, you know!"

day3_lunch_dain_unsure.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_unsure.text: *Looking slightly disappointed but quickly brightening up* "...Fine! Then I'll show you how special I can be! Just watch!"

day3_lunch_dain_friend.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_friend.text: *Her expression freezes for a moment before she forces a laugh* "...Ahaha, right? A friend. Yeah, friends. Haha!"

day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting side by side with Dain in the cafeteria, chatting. She's shier than usual.*
day3_lunch_dain_freetalk.context: ダインとランチ中。ダインが「私のこと、どう思ってる？」と真剣に聞いてきた。いつもの活発さの代わりに恥ずかしがっている。

day3_lunch_dain_end.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_end.text: "Anyway! You're coming to my practice tomorrow, right? You better come!"

day3_lunch_dain_promise.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_promise.text: "Great! Look forward to it! I'll show you my amazing spike!"

day3_lunch_dain_maybe.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_maybe.text: "...What, if you have time? Do you have other plans?"

day3_lunch_dain_suspicious.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_dain_suspicious.text: "Hmph, fine. But if you stand me up, I'll be really mad!"

day3_lunch_together_react.name: 僕
day3_lunch_together_react.text: *A moment of silence. Three pairs of eyes scan each other.*

day3_lunch_together_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_together_2.text: *Lunch in the cafeteria. The atmosphere is unusually tense.*

day3_lunch_together_3.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_together_3.text: "Hey, {name}. You're coming to see my volleyball practice tomorrow, right?"

day3_lunch_together_explosion.name: 僕
day3_lunch_together_explosion.text: *The air freezes rapidly. All eyes are on me.*

day3_lunch_together_silence.name: 僕
day3_lunch_together_silence.text: *A suffocating silence fills the air. Seoyeon's hands are trembling, Yuna's eyes darken, and Dain's expression hardens.*

day3_lunch_together_seoyeon_react.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_together_seoyeon_react.text: *Slowly putting down her spoon* "...So. I wasn't the only special one."

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie.text: *Standing up* "...I knew. That {name} didn't only promise me."

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_2.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_2.text: "Huh? Really? Then why did you come knowing that?!"

day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_3.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_together_yuna_lie_3.text: *Looking at me coldly* "...That was a lie. I didn't know either. I just... didn't want to cry in front of the others."

day3_lunch_together_confront.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_together_confront.text: "Wait... {name}, did you make promises with all of us?"

day3_lunch_apologize.name: 僕
day3_lunch_apologize.text: "I'm sorry... I couldn't say no to anyone..."

day3_lunch_apologize_react.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_apologize_react.text: "...Being honest is good, but still annoying."

day3_lunch_excuse.name: 僕
day3_lunch_excuse.text: "Well, the times are all different... Dain's in the morning, others in the evening..."

day3_lunch_excuse_react.name: ソヨン
day3_lunch_excuse_react.text: "That's not the problem... Ugh, I don't know. I'm confused too."

day3_lunch_excuse_react_2.name: ダイン
day3_lunch_excuse_react_2.text: "Hmm... can't you just manage your time well? I'm fine with it."

day3_lunch_excuse_react_3.name: ユナ
day3_lunch_excuse_react_3.text: "...Someone like you might be fine with that. But I... (stands up) I'm leaving first."

day3_lunch_run.name: 僕
day3_lunch_run.text: *I hurriedly finished my food and escaped. That was the worst choice.*

day3_lunch_together_end.name: 僕
day3_lunch_together_end.text: *Lunch ended in an awkward atmosphere. I'm worried about the weekend...*

day3_lunch_escape.name: 僕
day3_lunch_escape.text: "Oh, I just remembered something I need to do! See you later!"

day3_lunch_escape_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_escape_2.text: *I escaped the classroom as if running away. I think I heard sighs behind me...*

day3_lunch_single_approach.name: 僕
day3_lunch_single_approach.text: *It's lunch time. Who should I eat with?*

day3_lunch_nurse.name: 僕
day3_lunch_nurse.text: *I headed to the nurse's office during lunch. The teacher is eating a sandwich at her desk.*

day3_lunch_nurse_2.name: 保健先生
day3_lunch_nurse_2.text: *Beaming when she sees me* "Oh my, {name}! Have you eaten? Want to eat with teacher?"

day3_lunch_nurse_3.name: 保健先生
day3_lunch_nurse_3.text: *Locking the door* "Actually... I wanted some time alone with you. Watching out for the kids is exhausting."

day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.text: *Having lunch together in the nurse's office. My heart races at the secretive atmosphere.*
day3_lunch_nurse_freetalk.context: 保健室で保健先生と二人きりでランチ中。先生がドアに鍵をかけた。秘密のデートのような雰囲気。禁断の恋のときめき。

day3_lunch_nurse_4.name: 保健先生
day3_lunch_nurse_4.text: *Glancing at the clock with a sigh* "...Time's up. Get to class. See you Sunday."

day3_lunch_teacher.name: 僕
day3_lunch_teacher.text: *I visited the teachers' office during lunch. The teacher is having coffee alone.*

day3_lunch_teacher_2.name: 担任先生
day3_lunch_teacher_2.text: *Surprised to see me, then brightening up* "...{name}? What brings you here? It's my lunch break..."

day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.name: 僕
day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.text: *Having lunch with the homeroom teacher in the teachers' office.*
day3_lunch_teacher_freetalk.context: 教務室で担任先生と二人きりでランチ中。先生が恥ずかしそうにドアを閉めた。秘密のデートの雰囲気。

day3_lunch_teacher_4.name: 担任先生
day3_lunch_teacher_4.text: *Putting down her coffee cup* "...This shouldn't be happening. A student coming to spend lunch with a teacher, and the teacher enjoying it. Does that even make sense?"

day3_lunch_normal.name: 僕
day3_lunch_normal.text: *No special plans... I'll just have a normal lunch today.*

day3_lunch_normal_2.name: 僕
day3_lunch_normal_2.text: *I hear laughter around me. Everyone looks happy with their friends.*

day3_lunch_alone.name: 僕
day3_lunch_alone.text: *I quietly ate lunch alone. What should I do this weekend...*
